summary: Iteration 4 verified the Groq API swap. Backend: all 10 pytest cases in test_ai_features.py pass (login, generate 3-idea distinct/topic-specific/non-template, refine, chat, viva>=3 questions, save/list/delete, history, invalid Google session 502). Direct urban-beekeeping curl returned 3 topic-specific ideas with title/problem_statement/key_features(>=5)/tech_stack/roadmap/learning_outcomes populated in ~5-10s. No mock/template markers in server.py (grep confirms mock removed). Frontend E2E: login via UI, dashboard renders, Generate ideas produced 3 project-cards with bee-themed titles ('BeeHealth Insight Platform', 'Pollinator Classroom', 'Medicinal Honey Marketplace & Tracker'); details page opens and shows AI content. HOWEVER a REGRESSION was detected on count>=5: 3 consecutive count=5 requests (across different interests: space robotics, library management, urban beekeeping) all returned 503 AI_BUSY_MESSAGE. Root cause confirmed by direct Groq call: openai/gpt-oss-120b is a reasoning model that consumes reasoning tokens before content; without an explicit max_completion_tokens the default output cap truncates the JSON array (finish_reason='length', content_len=11876, no closing ']'), so parse_ideas returns None and the top-up loop also fails. Previous iteration on the Emergent provider had count=5 passing; this is a Groq-specific regression.

critical.issue: count=5 (and likely count=10) returns 503 'The AI mentor is busy'. Actual cause: Groq gpt-oss-120b response is truncated (finish_reason=length) because no max_completion_tokens is set and each idea has 21 required fields. parse_ideas cannot parse the incomplete JSON array. Fix: request larger output (e.g. max_completion_tokens 16384 or higher / model's max) and/or reduce fields-per-idea; also raise 503 with a more descriptive message when JSON parse fails vs when Groq returns 429.

minor.issue: logging.error uses default level; not visible in supervisor backend.err.log because Uvicorn logger is not configured for module logs. Groq 429/timeouts are silently swallowed and surface only as generic 503 to the user.
If final ideas list is shorter than requested count, ideas[:count] silently returns fewer items rather than 503. Should assert equality and raise a clear error when short.

rca of the issue: Regression: count>=5 returns 503. Reproduction: curl POST /api/projects/generate with any interests and count:5 -> {'detail': 'The AI mentor is busy...'}. Direct Groq test with the same prompt returns HTTP 200 with finish_reason='length' and 11876 chars of unclosed JSON. Because parse_ideas locates raw[find('['):rfind(']')+1] and no ']' exists in the truncated tail, json.loads fails; the top-up retry regenerates the same oversized prompt with the same truncation. Mitigation: add 'max_completion_tokens': 16384 (or higher supported by the model) to the Groq JSON body in ai_text(), or split generation into per-idea calls.
